facts.fact: The MoCTI Directorate of Technology, with a Software Development and Application Services Unit and a Data Science Unit, is stated to be mandated to support MDAs in planning, deploying and maintaining software, to build and maintain government-wide data infrastructure, and to direct delivery of e-Cabinet, e-Parliament and citizen portals; the page gives no date for the stated thing, so the published date is used.

note: Mandate page; no named system is stated as run, maintained or developed by directorate staff, and no go-live or cadre is stated, so only the agency fact is recorded.
